title: Introduce gradual profile calibration and release-snapshot changelog hook
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: onboarding new model variants often creates brittle performance profiles because initial lab runs don't capture production input variability. This PR adds a lightweight, gradual calibration mechanism that refines model performance profiles post-onboard using production-safe telemetry and controlled synthetic probes. It also implements a release-snapshot changelog hook that automatically captures metadata and profile deltas at release time and emits a machine-readable release note fragment for downstream release tooling.

What this changes: 
- profile/calibration: a new calibration pipeline that performs small, staged probe batches (configurable per-model) and updates the model profile's latency and token-distribution histograms. Calibration runs are throttled and labelled as "calibration:staged" to avoid polluting primary metrics.
- registry/hooks/release-snapshot: a git-hook-style release snapshot hook that collects pre/post-profile snapshots, computes a compact delta (latency P50/P95, token-cost, quantization-impact flags), and writes a release fragment to /releases/snapshots/<model_name>/<version>.json.
- CLI: new subcommands `redwood-registry calibrate --model <id> [--stages n]` and `redwood-registry release-snapshot --model <id> --version vX.Y.Z`. Both support --dry-run and --kiosk for interactive review.
- APIs: exposed endpoints to read calibration status and snapshot artifacts; internal-only endpoints require admin scope.

Design notes: 
- Calibration is gradual: default is 3 stages where each stage increases probe rate (0.1rps -> 0.5rps -> 1rps) and verifies stability against a rolling baseline window. If profile drifts > configured threshold, the run aborts and opens an alert.
- Safety: probes are synthetic and isolated from customer data paths; probes use small generated prompts and pinned model variants. Calibration metadata is stored separately and only merged into the canonical profile after a confidence check.
- Changelog snapshot: we intentionally keep snapshot format flat and deterministic to make diffs trivial for the release assembler; payload includes model_id, version, created_at, delta_metrics (p50,p95,cost_delta), quantization_changes, and tags.

Testing and verification: 
- Unit tests for calibration scheduler, delta computation and snapshot formatting.
- Integration tests that run a 3-stage calibration on a small test model (CI fixture) and assert profile convergence and snapshot creation.
- Manual validation run: we executed calibration on `gpt-small-test` in staging and validated no customer-facing metrics were affected.

Migration and rollout: 
- No DB schema changes. Profiles get an optional `calibrated_at` timestamp when merged. Existing profiles are untouched until calibration is explicitly run.
- Release snapshot hook is opt-in via config: `registry.release_snapshot.enabled = true`. Once enabled, release pipelines will pick up generated fragments.

Checklist: 
- [x] Calibration pipeline implementation
- [x] Release-snapshot hook and writer
- [x] CLI commands and docs stub
- [x] Tests and CI
- [x] Manual staging validation

Related: ENG-8043 (profile stability), PM-219 (release notes automation).

review_comments: Arjun Rao: overall looks good. Two questions: 1) Can we make the default probe rates smaller for the first-stage to be extra conservative? 2) Add a retention policy for snapshot artifacts?

Maya Patel: replied: 1) lowered stage1 from 0.2rps to 0.1rps per Arjun's suggestion; exposed probe-rate config in registry.config. 2) added retention config `release_snapshot.retention_days` default 90 and a garbage-collection job in registry/scheduler/gc.py
Liam Chen: requested changes: split heavy math in delta calc into util and add unit tests for edge cases (quantization negative deltas).
Maya Patel: addressed Liam's request and added tests for negative deltas and NaN handling. Pushed follow-up commit.
Evelyn Park: approved after verifying integration test logs and snapshot schema
release_notes: Add gradual post-onboard calibration pipeline and an opt-in release-snapshot changelog hook that records profile deltas (latency P50/P95, cost) for model releases. CLI commands `calibrate` and `release-snapshot` added. Configurable safety thresholds and retention settings.
